about: #331 타닥냥을 끌어 옮기기: the cases both apps run — Mac scripts/test-typing-cat.sh (PaperCore/TypingCat.swift: TypingCorner · TypingPlace), Windows test/typingCat.test.ts (src/core/typingCat.ts). Pressed on the drawn cat and dragged, the window follows; let go, it is kept wholly inside the usable area (Mac visibleFrame · Windows workArea) of the display it is mostly on (or the nearest), and that place is kept as 옮긴 자리 (`moved`): the display's id, the centre as a fraction of that area, and the centre itself (for when the display is gone). Rects are [x, y, width, height] in each app's own screen coordinates (Mac y up, Windows y down): nothing here depends on which way y goes. Numbers are compared to 1e-6.

drawn.about: The cat's drawn area: 16 bands from the top of its picture, each the part across it with paint in any of the three poses (null: none). `box` is the box around it. `at` is [across, down] as fractions of the window.

hits.case: D1 the middle of the cat: it takes the press
D2 the clear top left corner: the click goes to the app behind
D3 the clear top right corner
D4 the clear row under the cushion

dropped.case: P1 let go in the middle of the first display: it stays, kept as fractions of that display
P2 let go across two displays: on the one it is mostly on, wholly inside it
P3 let go past the bottom edge (the Dock · the taskbar): kept inside
P4 let go off every display: on the nearest, inside

restored.case: R1 opened again: the same place on the same display
R2 크기 made larger: the same centre
R3 크기 made smaller: the same centre
R4 near an edge, made larger: still wholly inside
R5 the display's resolution changed: as far across as before
R6 its display unplugged: on the display nearest where it was, wholly inside
R7 its display unplugged, its centre on the one left: there
R8 no displays at all: nothing (left where it is)

chosen.about: 자리 as chosen: 옮긴 자리 with a place kept sits there; a corner sits in that corner of `area` (each app's own corner rule, `frames` in typing-cat-cases.json) and the place stays kept, so 옮긴 자리 can be chosen again.

cases.case: C1 옮긴 자리 with a place: there
C2 a corner chosen after a drag: back in that corner
C3 another corner, made larger: flush in that corner
C4 옮긴 자리 with nothing kept: the corner unless changed

saved.case: W2 fractions past the edge are kept within 0…1
W5 not a place at all: nothing
